message:
fix(desktop): audition follows score edits + carries velocity; rest-to-note discoverable (#167, #168, #170) (#172)

Score edits rebuilt the playback table but never reloaded the synth or

the score clock, so the audition kept playing the pre-edit notes at the

old total length. reloadEditedScore now reloads the synth and updates

the clock span (new ScoreCursorClock.setDuration). The audition also

carries each note's detected velocity (matches the MIDI export), and

rest-to-note gets a CommandBar menu item + the N shortcut.

Closes #167

Closes #168

Closes #170
